name: Hostinger VPS

modes.label: Regular price, 24-month prepaid (amortized monthly)
modes.note: Estimator-only encoding: sizes.hour and month_cap both equal full monthly rent, with a one-hour synthetic minimum. This is NOT a vendor hourly tariff. For valid workloads with sessions >= peak concurrency it charges one monthly rental per concurrent machine, including off-hours. Setup/term cash outlays are caveated separately.

modes.label: 1-month term, no commitment (auto-renews monthly)

plans.name: Usage account
plans.note: Account quotas and stock availability must be checked before deploying 50 concurrent machines; no quota approval implied.

caveats: DIY infrastructure rather than an agent-managed sandbox: guest installation, HTTPS/domain setup, abuse controls and operations are customer responsibilities. Linux guest administrative capabilities are not preinstalled agent features. 30% guest CPU utilization does not reduce allocated-compute charges. Unknowns remain null; a partial subtotal is not a complete invoice.
Smallest captured >=4/8 shape is KVM4: 4vCPU/16GB/200GB; $12.99/month intro, $28.99/month renewal, both paid24months. 8GB KVM2 has only2vCPU and cannot satisfy4vCPU.
KVM4 upfront per machine $311.76 intro or $695.76 renewal; 50-machine cash outlay $15588 or $34788, not $649.50/$1449.50 total cash.
4/8/16/32TB transfer per KVM1/2/4/8 respectively. OneIPv4+IPv6 included; overage price not verified, so not assumed zero.
Snapshot zero is only within included product allowance, not proof of unlimited external50GB retention. Public API exists; no per-hour burst billing or cost-saving power-off.
Free snapshot field represents included product allowance only; no assumption that any quantity/lifetime of requested retained state is supported.

Sustained high CPU is throttled: Hostinger treats a VPS with long sustained high CPU as potentially compromised and cuts its CPU capacity by 25% per hour; the limit can be reset once per week. CPU-bound 24/7 fleets may not get the full vCPU they pay for.

Hostinger API is rate-limited to 90 requests per 60 s per token (RateLimit-Policy q=90;w=60); repeated 429s can get the IP temporarily blocked. VM creation via API is a purchase (POST /api/vps/v1/virtual-machines charges the default payment method). No published limit on the number of VPS per account.
Refunds: 30-day money-back covers new KVM VPS purchases and renewals, but VPS upgrades, VPS control-panel licences, Hostinger GPU and credits are non-refundable.
